description: Anonymous marketing HTML; respect the origin's cache and no-store policies
expression: (http.host eq "www.upforex.com" and http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} and http.request.uri.query eq "" and http.cookie eq "" and not any(http.request.headers["authorization"][*] ne "") and http.request.uri.path.extension eq "" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/admin") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api"))
